dismissals.because: apps/web/src/api/fetcher.ts:40 googleStartUrl builds the sign-in URL on apiOrigin, a separate origin: apps/web/README.md:14 and decision 0013 put the web app at https://<domain>.in and the API at https://api.<domain>.in, so the service worker (scope / on the web origin, vite.config.ts:12) never intercepts navigation to the API's /api/v1/auth/google/* routes; the app and API do not share one origin

findings.body: The app and API share one origin in production, but this Workbox navigation fallback has no exclusion for `/auth/google/start` or the OAuth callback. Once the service worker controls the page, clicking “Continue with Google” navigates to a URL that Workbox serves from the cached app shell instead of reaching the authentication endpoint. An installed member therefore cannot sign in again after expiry. Restrict the fallback to client routes or exclude the authentication routes. The install test uses a separate API port and misses this production path. [Workbox documents that the fallback handles navigation requests unless restricted](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/workbox/modules/workbox-webpack-plugin).
